description: Convert a file on this machine to another format with open-source converters compiled to WebAssembly: ImageMagick (images, raw photos), resvg (SVG), FFmpeg (audio, video), Pandoc (documents, markup), 7-Zip (archives), GDAL (geodata), Assimp (3D). Nothing is uploaded. Each engine is downloaded once on first use (2 to 59 MB, pinned versions, SHA-256 checked) into ~/.cache/openformatdb/engines. Call with only `path` to list what the file can become; chains of two engines are planned automatically (svg → png → webp). Writes next to the input unless `output` is given, and never overwrites a file.

output.description: Output file path (default: next to the input, same name, new extension)

path.description: File to convert (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

to.description: Target extension: webp, mp3, docx, kml, glb, zip…

name: convert_file
title: Convert a file locally
